items.title: ICE agents shoot a New Yorker with his five-year-old in the car
items.summary: ICE agents surrounded a car in Marble Hill, in upper Manhattan, and shot the driver while his five-year-old child was in the vehicle. Mayor Zohran Mamdani's video statement ("I am angry tonight... ICE makes this city less safe. We want them out.") got 395K likes, the most of any post that day, and "New Yorker" was X's top trend. NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch said the man, a Dominican national, was the target of the operation and had two prior arrests.
items.author: @NYCMayor

post.name: Mayor Zohran Kwame Mamdani
post.text:
I am angry tonight.

Because today ICE shot a New Yorker. They shot a New Yorker while his five year old child was in the car.

ICE makes this city less safe.

We want them out. Now.
